test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: No two of the six friends U, V, W, X, Y and Z, are of the same height. V is taller than only three other friends. Z is only taller than X. W is shorter than U only. Find who is the third shortest among all the friends.
solution:
Given: Six friends U, V, W, X, Y and Z.

V is taller than only three other friends. 

_ > _ > V > _ > _ > _

Z is only taller than X (This means X is the smallest and Z is the second smallest).

_ > _ > V > _ > Z > X

W is shorter than U only (This means U is the tallest and W is the second tallest).

U > W > V > _ > Z > X

And, Y will be sit at the remaining place.

U > W > V > Y > Z > X

So, Y is the third shortest among all the friends.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Y"**.
